answer.source: NASA / USGS Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) surface reflectance, 30 m, version 2.0, from NASA's Land Processes DAAC
answer.units: NDVI (greenness) of each 30 m square from its red and near-infrared surface reflectance, 0 is bare ground or dead plants and about 0.8 is thick healthy green; corners, lat and lon in decimal degrees; clear_share is the share of the inside squares that were clear on that pass
answer.note: How green each 30 m square of the field looked from space, from the clearest pass of each 15-day period, May to September of 2024 and 2025. A pass is kept only when at least 60 % of the squares wholly inside the field were clear. A square with cloud, cloud shadow, snow or water is null, never counted as low greenness.
